ctaHeading: Ready for your Braybrook cabinet project? Let's talk.
aboutText: With over 30 years of experience, Tamar Cabinets is Braybrook's trusted name for custom joinery. From stunning kitchen renovations to intricate bathroom vanities, we specialise in creating functional, beautifully crafted pieces tailored to your home. Our commitment to superb build quality and personalised design ensures every project, from our Braybrook workshop, is finished to the highest standard.
servicesText: We design and build a wide range of custom cabinetry for Braybrook and Melbourne's west. Our services cover everything from full kitchen transformations to specialised storage solutions, all crafted with precision in our local workshop.

services.title: Kitchen Cabinetry
services.desc: Complete kitchen design and manufacture, including custom sink cutouts and modern layouts.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Custom-built vanities and bathroom storage tailored to your space and style.

services.title: Wardrobes & Storage
services.desc: Bespoke wardrobes and storage systems to maximise organisation in any room.

services.title: Entertainment & Bar Units
services.desc: Stylish, custom-made units for home bars, media centres, and living spaces.

services.title: Laundry Cabinetry
services.desc: Practical and durable laundry cabinetry designed for functionality and flow.

services.title: General Custom Joinery
services.desc: Expert craftsmanship for any unique cabinetry project around your Braybrook home.
